description.value: Ava Bakery is a family-owned Persian bakery in Port Coquitlam, founded during the COVID-19 pandemic by a couple who pivoted from hospitality and healthcare into traditional Iranian baking. The shop specializes in authentic Persian breads — Taftoon, Barbary, Lavash, Shirmal, and whole wheat Barbari Naan — alongside pastries, sweets, and prepared dishes such as Haleem and Persian Noodle Soup. It offers touring cyclists a rare chance to stock up on freshly baked breads and traditional Iranian snacks in the Tri-Cities area.
